question: I changed my mind about a lamp that arrived three weeks ago. Can I still send it back?
answer: Yes. Three weeks is within the 40-day window from delivery, so you can return it if it's unused and in its original packaging with all accessories [1]. Note that a lamp that has had fuel in it cannot be returned [3]. To start, use the online store or call to get an RA number for the box [1].

calls.prompt:
Passages:

[1] faq.md > Can I send something back if I changed my mind?
### Can I send something back if I changed my mind?

Yes. You have 40 days from the day your order was delivered to return any unused item in its
original packaging with all its accessories. Start a return on the online store, or call us, and
you will get an RA number to put on the box.

[2] faq.md > My order arrived damaged. Do I have to send it back?
### My order arrived damaged. Do I have to send it back?

Write to us within 5 days of delivery with photos of the item and the box. We ship a replacement
right away. For items under $50 you keep or dispose of the damaged one; for items over $50 we send
a prepaid label and ask for the damaged item back.

[3] faq.md > Can I return a lantern I have already put fuel in?
### Can I return a lantern I have already put fuel in?

No. A fuel lantern or oil lamp that has had fuel in it cannot be returned, because we cannot ship
or resell it. If it is not working properly, it is covered by the warranty instead, and we will
repair or replace it.

[4] returns-policy.md > Common situations
## Common situations

A customer wants to return a lantern after 40 days. The answer is no, unless the holiday extension
applies. Agents may offer to check the item under warranty if there is a defect.

A customer bought a Firefly 220R (LS-220R) and meant to buy the Firefly 220 (LS-220). This is a
simple exchange; no restocking fee, and the replacement ships at once because the price
difference is under $50.

A customer has lit their new Northstar once in the backyard and does not like the sound of the
pressurized tank. The item cannot be returned; fuel has been put in it. The agent should explain
why and note that the warranty still covers any defect.

A customer's return arrived at the warehouse damaged in transit without insurance. The warehouse
photographs the damage and customer service offers a partial refund at the shift lead's
discretion; the customer is responsible for a return package until it arrives.

[5] faq.md > If I give a lantern as a gift, is it still under warranty?
### If I give a lantern as a gift, is it still under warranty?

Yes. The warranty transfers with a gift. It does not transfer if the lantern is resold.
